def: a struggle (properly, the state), i.e. (figuratively) anguish

occurrences.text: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
